status: source-controlled proof contract; production adapters remain separately approved
principle: A small business site is a branded customer front door paired with a truthful phone-first owner control surface. Every component keeps its identity when the business upgrades.

identity_contract.rule: IDs originate in the recipe and registry; they are not inferred from rendered markup, layout position, or copy.

components.truth_boundary: A visible window invites a request. It is never a confirmed appointment or a connected calendar.
The form does not receive data until the exact site is enabled and deployed; a submitted request is not a booked appointment.
Show only recorded state. Never display synthetic bookings, revenue, availability, analytics, or provider connections.
Provider, calendar, payment, DNS, and public-publish mutations require their separate authorization gates.
Opportunities are labeled hypotheses or measured outcomes, never guaranteed growth.
Proofs, research, and decisions stay in the authenticated customer workspace; email only notifies.

upgrade_rules: Move existing instances between page recipes without changing their instance IDs, business bindings, selected visual direction, or Build DNA lineage.
A new package may add components or routes, but it may not silently enable provider actions or replace an approved customer flow.
A component marked disabled-by-default requires exact site enablement and independent authorization before any external effect.
